description: An Android Activity class demonstrating layout animation with a grid of app icons using a custom adapter.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation1
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a grid of application icons with layout animation.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to supply app icon views for the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads applications, and sets up the grid view with an adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the system for launcher-type activities to display.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Generates or reuses ImageView for each app icon in the grid.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of app items to display, up to 32.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the app info object at a given position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.
